d.ko: Step into 1579 as Yasuke, the African samurai, and join Oda Nobunaga in his quest to unite Japan! Master precise katana combat, uncover secret gear, and unleash your ancestral power in this historically inspired action-packed journey through feudal Japan.
d.en: Step into 1579 as Yasuke, the African samurai, and join Oda Nobunaga in his quest to unite Japan! Master precise katana combat, uncover secret gear, and unleash your ancestral power in this historically inspired action-packed journey through feudal Japan.
d.zh: 踏入1579年，化身非洲武士弥助，加入织田信长的征途，助他一统日本！掌握精准的武士刀战斗技巧，发现隐藏装备，释放你祖先的力量，在这场充满历史灵感的战国冒险中奋勇前行！
